solomon.name: Solomon
solomon.role: King named in three collection headings
solomon.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
solomon.importance: His name connects the collections with remembered royal wisdom.
solomon.connections: The opening identifies him as David’s son and Israel’s king.

david.name: David
david.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
david.importance: The family name connects the opening with Israel’s earlier king.
david.connections: The opening uses his name to identify Solomon’s family.

hezekiah.name: Hezekiah
hezekiah.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
hezekiah.importance: Their work shows sayings being collected after Solomon’s time.
hezekiah.connections: Chapter 25 names his men as copying sayings associated with Solomon.

parents-proverbs.name: The teaching parents
parents-proverbs.role: Father and mother who guide a learner
parents-proverbs.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
parents-proverbs.importance: Their teaching prepares him to resist pressure from others.
parents-proverbs.connections: The teacher urges a son to hear both parents.

wisdom-proverbs.name: Woman Wisdom
wisdom-proverbs.role: Wisdom pictured as a woman who speaks
wisdom-proverbs.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
wisdom-proverbs.importance: Her voice lets the poems show wisdom teaching, warning, and welcoming.
wisdom-proverbs.connections: She calls publicly, praises fair conduct, and invites learners to her table.

folly-proverbs.name: Woman Folly
folly-proverbs.role: Foolishness pictured as a woman who invites guests
folly-proverbs.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
folly-proverbs.importance: Her welcome imitates Wisdom’s invitation while leading guests toward death.
folly-proverbs.connections: She offers stolen food. Her guests do not understand the danger.

unfaithful-woman-proverbs.name: The woman in the adultery warnings
unfaithful-woman-proverbs.role: Married woman who seeks another partner
unfaithful-woman-proverbs.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
unfaithful-woman-proverbs.importance: The teacher contrasts her promises with harm to people and marriages.
unfaithful-woman-proverbs.connections: In chapter 7, she tells a young man her husband is away.

young-learner-proverbs.name: The young man in chapter 7
young-learner-proverbs.role: Learner who follows a tempting invitation
young-learner-proverbs.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
young-learner-proverbs.importance: He notices the invitation without understanding where his choice leads.
young-learner-proverbs.connections: The teacher observes him walking toward the woman’s house.

agur.name: Agur
agur.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
agur.importance: His request addresses dangers he sees in both hunger and wealth.
agur.connections: The heading calls him Jakeh’s son. He asks God for enough food.

agur-named-men.name: Jakeh, Ithiel, and Ucal
agur-named-men.role: Names in the introduction to Agur’s words
agur-named-men.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
agur-named-men.importance: These names introduce the speech. The verse gives no further account of their actions.
agur-named-men.connections: WEB names Jakeh as Agur’s father and mentions Ithiel and Ucal.

lemuel.name: Lemuel
lemuel.role: King who recalls his mother’s teaching
lemuel.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
lemuel.importance: Her advice connects his private habits with his public duties.
lemuel.connections: His mother urges him to protect poor people and judge fairly.

lemuel-mother.name: Lemuel’s mother
lemuel-mother.role: Teacher who advises her royal son
lemuel-mother.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
lemuel-mother.importance: She tells him to speak for people who cannot defend themselves.
lemuel-mother.connections: She warns against drink that makes rulers forget people’s rights.

capable-woman-proverbs.name: The capable woman
capable-woman-proverbs.role: Woman praised for work, care, and wise speech
capable-woman-proverbs.life: Birth and death years are not securely known.
capable-woman-proverbs.importance: Her family praises work that supports the household and benefits neighbors.
capable-woman-proverbs.connections: She manages trade, buys a field, plants a vineyard, and helps poor people.
